messages:
ana: Quick sync  unexpected: a handful of customers flagged invoice mismatches after last week's price-sheet rollout (PS-SEP-30). Need ops + vendor reconciliation plan. :rotating_light:

jess: Can you paste an example? Are these usage rounding issues, marketplace SKUs, or reserved commit mapping?

mike: Here's one example from acct_998: they were charged new on-demand unit rate even though they had a reserved commit that should've kept legacy rate through renewal. Invoice shows line item 'usage_on_demand' with price_version PS-SEP-30.

rebecca: Marketplace note: some partner SKUs map to multiple internal tiers. If our mapping logic picks the closest tier post-rollout, partner payouts can be misaligned. We'll need a reconciliation CSV for partner-ops.

sandeep: Looking at request logs, a subset of requests from that account had header X-Redwood-Price-Version=unset because the proxy cached an older routing table. That would cause new rates to apply incorrectly. I'm patching proxy TTL rules now.

nate: Billing-side: for accounts that were mischarged, prefer issuing a one-line credit on next invoice rather than rewriting historical invoices. Simpler for audit. We'll tag credits with approval_id and original_invoice_id.

jess: Agreed. Ledger plan: create credit row with ledger_tag=rate_dispute, metadata: price_version, reason_code, approval_id. We'll cap credits to the invoice amount and carryover remainder to account balance.

olivia: Legal check: ensure the credit memo wording clarifies it's corrective and not a concession. Also confirm any customer agreements that forbid unilateral credits (rare).

rebecca: For Marketplace-impacted accounts, partner-ops needs a reconciliation file with columns: account_id, partner_sku, original_partner_payout, corrected_partner_payout, note. We'll coordinate with partners before issuing credits that affect partner commissions.

mike: Analytics: please include cohort_label (e.g., rollout-batch-3), renew_date, and commit_type in the recon export. We need to compute realized MRR delta after corrections.

sandeep: I'll add an endpoint /v1/billing/recon for CSV export and emit trace when price header missing. Also will push a proxy hotfix to avoid stale routing table issues. ETA 3-4 hours for hotfix, 1 day for export endpoint.

nate: Ops question: do we allow support to approve credits up to $1k, and finance-only for >$1k? We should codify approval thresholds and store approver_id.

jess: Yes. Support auto-approve up to $1k with a two-line justification macro; finance approval required above that. We'll store approval_id in ledger and include in audit export.

billing-bot: Reminder: billing calendar lock 2030-09-30 22:00 UTC. Any reconciliation files submitted after lock will apply to the following cycle.

ana: Action items: 1) eng proxy hotfix + recon endpoint (sandeep)  hotfix now, PR for export by EOD. 2) ledger credit spec + approval thresholds (jess + nate)  4 hours. 3) partner recon CSV schema (rebecca)  6 hours. 4) analytics export fields (mike)  today. 5) legal wording for credit memos (olivia)  EOD.

mike: I'll run a quick cohort scan and post a list of potentially affected accounts within 2 hours.

sandeep: Hotfix deployed. Proxy TTL reduced and cache invalidation patched. Starting recon export work now.

jess: Drafted ledger credit flow and support macro, uploading to #finance-docs. Support to standby for credit issuance once we have recon CSV.

rebecca: Partner-ops confirmed they can accept the CSV; they'll hold partner payouts until we finalize corrected payouts for impacted accounts.

ana: Great turnaround. Prioritize transparency with customers (support macros + invoice notes). If partner disputes surface, escalate to me. We'll delay further rollouts until recon process is stable. :white_check_mark:
